pages.text: Nearly all armor, tools, weapons and accessories can be reforged to change the modifier it has, rarer modifiers provide more potent buffs..

To reforge you need an Anvil and a hammer that corresponds to the type of item you want to reforge, an Armorers hammer for armor and accessories and a Weaponsmiths hammer for weapons (tools cannot currently be reforged, next update that'll be added).
You can craft the necessary hammers for the item you want to reforge using cloggrum ingots and sticks, check JEI for the recipes.

To be able to reforge an item, it must be full durability and must not have the Extended reforge, as all items with this reforge become unreforgeable. $(br)$(br)Do bear in mind not all items can be reforged, it's monitored by tags, and not all are included.
